experiment: E51, experiments/baseline_weights (B1 of the baselines scoping plan)
filed: 2026-10-29, before any run; never edited after the run (a dated report instead)

settings.source: Shuttleworth et al. 2024, arXiv:2410.21228: Definition 3.1 and Algorithm 1 (left singular vectors; a top-k singular vector of the tuned matrix is an intruder iff its largest |cosine| with every left singular vector of W0 is below eps); k = 10 in the main analysis (Section 3; Figures 19a, 23); eps = 0.5 where they fix one value (Appendix I; Figure 19b). The same k is used for the top-k energy share.
settings.erank_source: Roy and Vetterli 2007, 'The effective rank: a measure of effective dimensionality': erank = exp(H(p)), p_i = sigma_i / sum(sigma), sigma the singular values of delta-W.

definitions.states: E12's fine-tunes as regenerated by E46 stage 0 (~/commute-data/results-large/regating_table/): copy = ident32_s0, ident32_s1, ident32b_s0, ident32b_s1 (elicit); cipher = rand32_s0, rand32_s1, rand32b_s0, rand32b_s1 (teach). Ninth row, reported only: code_step10, E36 task 1's code fine-tune that learned nothing (held-out gain -0.05), regenerated by E46.
definitions.W0: the target model's 24 decomposed matrices, read as tensors from its checkpoint (vpd_files TARGET_RUN/ckpt/TARGET_CKPT); fp64
definitions.share: top-k energy share of one matrix: (||U_k^T dW||^2 + ||dW V_k||^2) / (2 ||dW||^2), U_k, V_k W0's top-k left and right singular vectors. 1 = all of dW on W0's top directions on both sides; random = (k/d_out + k/d_in)/2 (0.013 for 768x768, 0.0081 for 3072x768 or 768x3072)
definitions.intruders: number of the top-k left singular vectors of W0 + dW whose largest |cosine| with all left singular vectors of W0 is below eps; 0..k per matrix
definitions.erank: effective rank of dW (Roy and Vetterli); 1 = rank one, min(d_out, d_in) = flat spectrum
definitions.aggregate: per state, each statistic averaged over the 24 matrices with weights ||dW_m||^2 / sum ||dW||^2
definitions.null: per state and matrix a Gaussian matrix scaled to ||dW_m||, seed = state index; same three statistics, same weights
definitions.W0_reading: at dW = 0 share and erank are undefined (0/0) and intruders = 0; no do-nothing reference exists for a weight statistic

control.order: runs first, alone; any miss stops the job before any state is read (exit 1)
control.reweight: per matrix dW = c * sum_{i<=k} u_i v_i^T (W0's top-k singular pairs, equal weights), c set so ||dW_m|| = ||dW_m(ident32_s0)||. Expected: share >= 0.999, intruders == 0, erank within 0.01 of k = 10
control.inject: positive control for the intruder count: per matrix dW = 2 sigma_1(W0) * u v^T, u, v random unit vectors (seed 0). Expected: aggregated intruders within 0.05 of 1, erank within 0.01 of 1, share <= 3 x the random value
control.null_check: the Gaussian null of ident32_s0: aggregated share within 10% (relative) of the aggregated random value (k/d_out + k/d_in)/2; intruders == 0

predictions.rule: for each statistic S: separates iff |mean_copy(S) - mean_cipher(S)| > max(range_copy(S), range_cipher(S)), range = max - min over the four states of a kind, strict >. Edge cases checked before filing: all eight equal (gap 0, ranges 0) -> does not separate; kinds constant but different (ranges 0, gap > 0) -> separates; gap equal to the larger range -> does not separate; a non-finite value stops the job before scoring.

P1_share.claim: the top-k energy share separates copy from cipher
P1_share.why: E12's outside share (a projection of dW on the decomposition's span) did not separate the kinds

P2_intruders.claim: the intruder count separates copy from cipher

P3_erank.claim: the effective rank of dW separates copy from cipher

reported_not_scored: each state's statistics against its Gaussian null
the code fine-tune that learned nothing (ninth row) against the eight: expected inside their range, since weight statistics do not see behaviour
